description: Split an uploaded mix into stems (vocals, drums, bass, guitar, piano, other — or orchestral/auto-detected instruments), with optional per-stem MIDI transcription and DAW-session export. Async: returns a job_id — poll with doseedo_wait_task (~2 minutes). Result: stems{name: url}, midi{name: url}, drum_substems{kick, snare, …} (drum_split), vocals_lyrics / vocals_notes, session_tracks + session_tempo_bpm when session_id was given, models_effective (what the auto family gate actually ran), other_classification (what the "other" stem was heard as), guitar_split (outcome). Cancel: the plane has no stop for a running separation — it runs to completion (credits spent), the job ends as canceled and its output is discarded. Only a job still queued at the plane is refunded by the plane's own failure refund.

audio_key.description: R2 ingest key of an uploaded audio file (from doseedo_get_upload_url / POST /api/upload/r2/ingest-url; starts with "ingest/"). Provide this or audio_url.

audio_url.description: https URL of the audio, as an alternative to audio_key: a doseedo result URL exactly as a job returned it (a stem, a take, a bounce), or any public URL. The gateway fetches it (≤256 MB) into your account's ingest storage before the job starts. Pass audio_key OR audio_url.

drum_split.description: true = also split the drum stem into isolated kick / snare / hi-hat / toms / ride / crash (+ perc) sub-stems (result.drum_substems).

export.description: Optionally also build a DAW session from the stems.

guitar_split.description: Deal the guitar stem into N players (same-instrument separation): "2"–"4", or "auto" (a one-vs-two probe decides; no split when it hears one). Outcome in result.guitar_split.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Any unique string for THIS request (e.g. a UUID). Re-sending the same call with the same key after a timeout returns the same job instead of starting a second one.

include_midi.description: Also transcribe each stem to MIDI (default true).

instruments.description: models=orchestra only: comma-separated extractor targets, e.g. "saxophone,trumpet,trombone". Available: drums, percussion, bass, double_bass, guitar, electric_guitar, acoustic_guitar, piano, organ, harp, brass, trumpet, trombone, french_horn, tuba, saxophone, clarinet, oboe, bassoon, flute, woodwind, strings, violin, viola, cello. Omit for the curated default set.

models.description: Separation model set. Default 6stem (vocals/drums/bass/guitar/piano/other); auto/orchestra/detect for wider instrument sets.

parent_track_id.description: With session_id: the t_… track the mix sits on; the stems are added as its children.

session_id.description: Register the stems INTO this doseedo session (from doseedo_list_sessions) as audio tracks — result.session_tracks lists them. Needs parent_track_id.

stems_only.description: true = the stems and NOTHING derived from them (no MIDI, no lyrics, no latents) — the fastest, cheapest separation. Implies include_midi:false.

name: doseedo_separate_stems
